question: Identify the type of the pronoun. (5)
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3) Reflexive pronoun**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **reflexive pronoun** refers back to the subject of the sentence and is used when the subject and the object are the same. (निजवाचक सर्वनाम)
 
• Examples of reflexive pronouns include: *myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves*.
 
• In the given context, pronouns like **itself** are used, showing that consciousness shapes and reflects back on **itself**.
 
• Thus, the correct type of pronoun in (5) is **Reflexive pronoun**.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3) Reflexive pronoun**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 1: Possessive pronoun (संबंधवाचक सर्वनाम)** – Shows ownership, e.g., *mine, yours, his, hers, theirs*.**
 **Example:** This book is mine__.
 
• **Option 2: Demonstrative pronoun (संकेतवाचक सर्वनाम)** – Points to specific things, e.g., *this, that, these, those*.

 **Example:** __These__ are my shoes.
 
• **Option 4: Interrogative pronoun (प्रश्नवाचक सर्वनाम)** – Used to ask questions, e.g., *who, whom, whose, which, what*.

 **Example:** __Which__ is your pen?
